name: loopboard
description: Close the loop between conversation and work: gather Slack discussions and Jira issues onto a Miro board, synthesise themes and proposed tickets, then export the board's cards and stickies back to Jira as issues.

slack_token.title: Slack token
slack_token.description: Slack user (xoxp-) or bot (xoxb-) token with channels:read, channels:history and users:read. Add groups:read and groups:history for private channels.

miro_token.title: Miro access token
miro_token.description: OAuth access token from a Miro developer app with boards:read and boards:write.

jira_site_url.title: Jira site URL
jira_site_url.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

jira_email.title: Jira account email
jira_email.description: The Atlassian account email the API token belongs to.
